functions.purpose: Monster aim / target-lead computation. Pops the front of a small ring/deque of recorded target positions (history samples at +0x21a4..+0x21a8, 0xc-byte stride: Vec3 + 1 float), then transforms the relative target vector (targetPos - param) by the entity's orientation quaternion (matrix col fetched via vtbl+0xd0) using the standard q*v reflection formula, and forwards the result to FUN_10dba840. When debug flag *(DAT_1202e818+0x7c)+0xabc is set it draws a debug sphere labelled 'MonsterAim'.
formulas: sample pop: reads Vec3 local_20 = *(hist-0xc), scalar local_18 = *(hist-4); advances tail: *(param_1+0x21a8) -= 0xc
quat-rotate-vector reflection: v' = rel + 2*( cross(q.xyz, cross(q.xyz,rel) + q.w*rel) ); components use q.xyz XORed with sign mask DAT_11de9c90 (float negate) matching Ghidra's q*v*q^-1 expansion
functions.serverRelevance: client-only as decompiled (draws MonsterAim debug geometry); the leading/aim math itself may mirror server target-prediction but here it is a client render/debug path
functions.notes: History buffer of past target positions used for aim smoothing/lead. DAT_11de9c90 is the 0x80000000 float sign-flip mask.

functions.purpose: Damage-reception handler that aggregates a HitDescriptor's damage components, then fires a 'DamageEvent' into the monster's BehaviorTreeBase blackboard with AttackDir, HitDamage, HitPoint, AttackerID, AttackAttr. Also raises the 'MHOnDamage' script event and marks the entity dirty (network 0x70,5). Gates on attack-attribute mask matching (param_1+0x30 & attrFlags). This is the aggro/threat input path from combat into AI.
formulas: damage array param_3 (pfVar1): [0..5] are 6 damage components (element/status channels)
HitDamage = (int)ceil(pfVar1[0]) + (int)ceil(pfVar1[1] + DAT_11de9890 + pfVar1[2] + pfVar1[3] + pfVar1[4] + pfVar1[5])
attr-flag detection: fields param_3[0x1a],[0x1c],[0x1e],[0x20] compared == 1.4013e-45 (float bit-pattern 0x00000001) to find the active attack-attr slot; if none, sets pfVar1[0x1b]=1.4013e-45
if attacker entity type (vtbl+0xa8) == 2 : OR flag 8 into the attr word (pfVar7[1] |= 8) — flags a special hit class
gate: (*(param_1+0x30) & (uint)pfVar7[1]) != 0  (attack-attr mask must intersect monster's accepted mask)
AttackDir = attackerPos - hitEntityPos (per-axis subtraction of two Vec3 fetched via vtbl+0x94)
on gate-fail: zeroes all 6 damage components (damage nullified)
costs: HitDamage rounding: each channel ceil()'d; channels 1-5 summed then ceil'd together, channel 0 ceil'd separately, results added
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative/validation (damage aggregation + attack-attribute gating decides whether a hit registers and how much; feeds BT/aggro). In MHO server drives monsters, so this math is the reference for HitDamage and attack-attr acceptance even though the code path is client-side BT.
functions.notes: CBuffInfo::SerializeHitDamageMessage64 packs the damage msg; HitDescriptor::ComputeAttackAttrMask supplies AttackAttr. DAT_11de9890 is the small epsilon also used in FX. The 6-component damage vector + attack-attr mask is the core hit model.

functions.serverRelevance: client-only (network client that connects to the authoritative Battle Server and requests player spawn/init)
functions.notes: 'Cli' prefix = client. Uses shared-memory / networksink handshake. Companion 1129fae0 is the receive path.

functions.purpose: CLIENT handler for the 'Player Init Msg' received from the network sink (completes the spawn handshake started by 1129ddf0). Parses the message, creates/looks up the local player entity, copies the full player-state blob into the manager, and initializes rank/hunt-count UI and combat state. Sets ready flags (+0x109784=1, +0x84db8=1).
formulas: memcpy player-state blob: memcpy(param_1+0x14, msg, 0x8498e) when host is the server-authority (+0x6c getter)
reads hunt rank/count via CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount for UI (FUN_11398580 rank frame)
special-hit / difficulty field at msg+0x5e483 (flag) and msg+0x5f697 (added to +0x48c counter)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (deserializes authoritative player state pushed by server; 0x8498e-byte player blob)
functions.notes: Player-state blob size 0x8498e bytes copied verbatim from server message — useful for sizing the server->client player-init packet.
